examples.question: List the first 3 movies that have been directed by actors.
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie)<-[:DIRECTED]-(p) RETURN m.title LIMIT 3

examples.question: List the movies released in the year the user "Omar Huffman" was born.
examples.cypher: MATCH (u:User {name: "Omar Huffman"})-[:RATED]->(m:Movie) WITH u,  substring(m.released, 1, 4) AS userBirthYear MATCH (movie:Movie) WHERE substring(movie.released, 1, 4) = userBirthYear RETURN DISTINCT movie.title

examples.question: List the first 5 directors who have directed a movie with an imdbRating of 9 or higher.
examples.cypher: MATCH (d:Director)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.imdbRating >= 9 RETURN DISTINCT d.name LIMIT 5

examples.question: Which three directors have directed movies in more than one language?
examples.cypher: MATCH (d:Director)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WITH d, collect(DISTINCT m.languages) AS languages WHERE size(languages) > 1 RETURN d.name, languages ORDER BY size(languages) DESC LIMIT 3

examples.question: What are the IMDb ratings of movies that have a plot mentioning 'evil exterminator'?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.plot CONTAINS 'evil exterminator' RETURN m.title, m.imdbRating

examples.question: List the top 3 movies with the highest budget to revenue ratio.
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.budget IS NOT NULL AND m.revenue IS NOT NULL AND m.revenue > 0 RETURN m.title, m.budget, m.revenue, (toFloat(m.budget) / m.revenue) AS budgetToRevenueRatio ORDER BY budgetToRevenueRatio DESC LIMIT 3

examples.question: What is the average budget for movies in the "Science Fiction" genre?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre {name: 'Science Fiction'}) RETURN avg(m.budget)

examples.question: List the top 3 movies with the most revenue that have a runtime under 90 minutes.
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.runtime < 90 AND exists((m)<-[:RATED]-()) RETURN m.title AS movie, m.revenue AS revenue ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 3

examples.question: List the top 5 users who have given the highest average ratings to movies.
examples.cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[r:RATED]->(m:Movie) WITH u, AVG(r.rating) AS avgRating ORDER BY avgRating DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN u.userId, u.name, avgRating

examples.question: What are the first 3 movies where the main actor was born in France?
examples.cypher: MATCH (a:Actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WHERE a.bornIn = 'France' RETURN m.title LIMIT 3

examples.question: Which country has produced the most movies in the database?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) UNWIND m.countries AS country WITH country, COUNT(DISTINCT m) AS movieCount ORDER BY movieCount DESC RETURN country, movieCount LIMIT 1

examples.question: What are the first 3 movies with the most number of associated actors?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(a:Actor) WITH m, COUNT(a) AS actorCount ORDER BY actorCount DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN m.title AS movieTitle, actorCount

examples.question: What are the first 5 movies directed by directors born in the USA?
examples.cypher: MATCH (d:Director {bornIn: 'USA'})-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) RETURN m.title LIMIT 5

examples.question: Who are the top 5 actors by the number of movies acted in the 'Adventure' genre?
examples.cypher: MATCH (a:Actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre {name: 'Adventure'}) WITH a, count(m) AS movieCount ORDER BY movieCount DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN a.name AS actor, movieCount

examples.question: Which three genres have the lowest average IMDb rating?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) WHERE m.imdbRating IS NOT NULL WITH g.name AS genre, avg(m.imdbRating) AS avgRating RETURN genre, avgRating ORDER BY avgRating ASC LIMIT 3

examples.question: List the top 5 movies with the largest budgets released before 2000.
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.year < 2000 RETURN m.title AS title, m.budget AS budget ORDER BY m.budget DESC LIMIT 5

examples.question: List the top 5 movies that have been rated after 2015.
examples.cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[r:RATED]->(m:Movie) WHERE r.timestamp > 1451606400 RETURN m.title, m.year, r.rating ORDER BY r.timestamp DESC LIMIT 5

examples.question: Which 3 movies released in the last 5 years of the database have the highest imdbVotes?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.year >= 2012 RETURN m.title, m.year, m.imdbVotes ORDER BY m.imdbVotes DESC LIMIT 3

examples.question: Which 3 directors have the most movies with a runtime over 180 minutes?
examples.cypher: MATCH (d:Director)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.runtime > 180 WITH d, COUNT(m) AS movieCount ORDER BY movieCount DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN d.name AS directorName, movieCount

examples.question: Which 5 directors have directed movies in more than three different countries?
examples.cypher: MATCH (d:Director)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WITH d, count(DISTINCT m.countries) AS numCountries WHERE numCountries > 3 RETURN d.name, numCountries ORDER BY numCountries DESC LIMIT 5

examples.question: List the first 5 movies that have been directed by women.
examples.cypher: MATCH (director:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(movie:Movie) WHERE director.name =~ "(?i).*\\b(Ms\\.|Miss|Mrs\\.|Madam|Madame|Mademoiselle|Frau|Fräulein|Señora|Señorita|Doña|Donna)\\b.*" RETURN movie.title LIMIT 5

examples.question: Which movie had the largest number of actors participating?
examples.cypher: MATCH (a:Actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) RETURN m.title AS Movie, count(a) AS NumberOfActors ORDER BY NumberOfActors DESC LIMIT 1

examples.question: Which movies have actors who were born in the USA and have acted in a comedy genre?
examples.cypher: MATCH (a:Actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) WHERE a.bornIn = "USA" AND g.name = "Comedy" RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle, a.name AS ActorName

examples.question: What are the first 5 movies with the most distinct genres associated with them?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) WITH m, count(DISTINCT g) AS genreCount ORDER BY genreCount DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN m.title AS movieTitle, genreCount

examples.question: Identify the first 5 actors who have acted in movies with a budget less than 50 million dollars.
examples.cypher: MATCH (a:Actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.budget < 50000000 RETURN a.name LIMIT 5

examples.question: What are the first 3 movies that were released in the USA?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE 'USA' IN m.countries RETURN m.title, m.released ORDER BY m.released LIMIT 3

examples.question: List the first 3 actors who have a tmdbId but no imdbId.
examples.cypher: MATCH (a:Actor) WHERE a.tmdbId IS NOT NULL AND a.imdbId IS NULL RETURN a.name LIMIT 3

examples.question: List the names of actors born before 1950 who have acted in movies with an IMDb rating above 8.0.
examples.cypher: MATCH (actor:Actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(movie:Movie) WHERE actor.born < date('1950-01-01') AND movie.imdbRating > 8.0 RETURN DISTINCT actor.name

examples.question: List the top 3 directors based on the number of different countries their movies have been released in.
examples.cypher: MATCH (d:Director)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) UNWIND m.countries AS country WITH d, COUNT(DISTINCT country) AS countryCount RETURN d.name AS directorName, countryCount ORDER BY countryCount DESC LIMIT 3

examples.question: Name the top 5 movies that have been rated by users named 'Omar Huffman'.
examples.cypher: MATCH (u:User {name: 'Omar Huffman'})-[:RATED]->(m:Movie) RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle, m.imdbRating AS IMDbRating ORDER BY m.imdbRating DESC LIMIT 5

examples.question: List the top 3 actors with the highest average imdbRating across movies they've acted in (minimum 3 movies).
examples.cypher: MATCH (a:Actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.imdbRating IS NOT NULL WITH a, avg(m.imdbRating) AS avgRating, count(m) AS numMovies WHERE numMovies >= 3 RETURN a.name AS actor, avgRating ORDER BY avgRating DESC LIMIT 3

examples.question: Which actors have acted in movies from at least three different countries?
examples.cypher: MATCH (a:Actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WITH a, collect(DISTINCT m.countries) AS countries WHERE size(countries) >= 3 RETURN a.name AS actorName

examples.question: Which 3 directors have directed movies in more than three different genres?
examples.cypher: MATCH (d:Director)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) WITH d, count(DISTINCT g) AS num_genres WHERE num_genres > 3 RETURN d.name AS director, num_genres ORDER BY num_genres DESC LIMIT 3

examples.question: Which three actors have acted in movies in more than 3 different languages?
examples.cypher: MATCH (a:Actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WITH a, count(DISTINCT m.languages) AS numLanguages WHERE numLanguages > 3 RETURN a.name, numLanguages ORDER BY numLanguages DESC LIMIT 3

examples.question: Who are the directors of movies that have an IMDb rating greater than 8.0?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:DIRECTED]-(d:Director) WHERE m.imdbRating > 8.0 RETURN DISTINCT d.name

examples.question: What are the top 5 movies by revenue that were released in languages other than English?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE NOT 'English' IN m.languages RETURN m.title, m.revenue ORDER BY m.revenue DESC LIMIT 5

examples.question: List the first 3 movies released in the year 2000 or later with a rating under 5.
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[r:RATED]->() WHERE m.year >= 2000 AND r.rating < 5 RETURN m ORDER BY m.released LIMIT 3

examples.question: What are the first 3 movies with an actor born before 1900?
examples.cypher: MATCH (a:Actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WHERE a.born < date("1900-01-01") RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle, m.year AS ReleaseYear ORDER BY m.year ASC LIMIT 3

examples.question: List the first 3 movies with a budget over 100 million dollars.
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.budget > 100000000 RETURN m.title, m.budget ORDER BY m.budget DESC LIMIT 3

examples.question: What are the top 5 movies with the most countries listed in their production?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) RETURN m.title AS title, size(m.countries) AS countryCount ORDER BY countryCount DESC LIMIT 5

examples.question: Find the actors who have starred in movies with a release date before their birth.
examples.cypher: MATCH (a:Actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WHERE date(m.released) < a.born RETURN DISTINCT a.name

examples.question: Which genres have the most movies with a runtime over 120 minutes?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) WHERE m.runtime > 120 RETURN g.name AS Genre, count(m) AS MovieCount ORDER BY MovieCount DESC

examples.question: List the first 3 directors born before 1950.
examples.cypher: MATCH (d:Director) WHERE d.born < date('1950-01-01') RETURN d ORDER BY d.born LIMIT 3

examples.question: List all users who have rated the same movie with different ratings.
examples.cypher: MATCH (u1:User)-[r1:RATED]->(m:Movie)<-[r2:RATED]-(u2:User) WHERE u1 <> u2 AND r1.rating <> r2.rating RETURN u1, u2, m

examples.question: Which actors have acted in movies from at least three different countries?
examples.cypher: MATCH (a:Actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WITH a, collect(DISTINCT m.countries) AS countries WHERE size(countries) >= 3 RETURN a.name, countries

examples.question: What is the average IMDB rating of movies in the "Adventure" genre?
examples.cypher: MATCH (g:Genre {name: 'Adventure'}) MATCH (g)<-[:IN_GENRE]-(m:Movie) WITH avg(m.imdbRating) AS averageRating RETURN averageRating

examples.question: Which movies have actors who have also directed a movie?
examples.cypher: MATCH (actor:Actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(movie:Movie) WHERE exists{ (actor)-[:DIRECTED]->(:Movie) } RETURN movie.title, actor.name

examples.question: Which 3 directors have directed movies in more than three genres?
examples.cypher: MATCH (d:Director)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) WITH d, count(DISTINCT g) AS genreCount WHERE genreCount > 3 RETURN d.name AS Director, genreCount ORDER BY genreCount DESC LIMIT 3

examples.question: Which country has produced the most movies with a budget greater than 100 million dollars?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.budget > 100000000 UNWIND m.countries AS country WITH country, count(DISTINCT m) AS movieCount ORDER BY movieCount DESC RETURN country, movieCount LIMIT 1

examples.question: Which three movies have been rated by the youngest users on average?
examples.cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[r:RATED]->(m:Movie) WITH m, avg(toInteger(u.userId)) AS avgUserId ORDER BY avgUserId ASC LIMIT 3 RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle, avgUserId AS AverageUserId

examples.question: What is the average IMDB rating of all movies?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WITH avg(m.imdbRating) AS averageRating RETURN averageRating

examples.question: List the top 5 actors with the most roles in movies released before 1980.
examples.cypher: MATCH (a:Actor)-[r:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.year < 1980 WITH a, count(r) AS numRoles ORDER BY numRoles DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN a.name AS actor, numRoles

examples.question: Which 3 users have given the highest average rating to movies they've rated?
examples.cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[r:RATED]->(m:Movie) WITH u, avg(r.rating) AS avgRating ORDER BY avgRating DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN u.name AS userName, avgRating

examples.question: Which movie has the most languages?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WITH m, size(m.languages) AS num_languages ORDER BY num_languages DESC RETURN m.title, num_languages LIMIT 1

examples.question: List the movies that have been filmed in IMAX and have a revenue greater than 500 million.
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.revenue > 500000000 RETURN m

examples.question: Find all movies that have been rated exactly 5 times.
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE count{(u:User)-[:RATED]->(m)} = 5 RETURN m

examples.question: List the first 3 movies with the highest box office revenue of all time.
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WITH m ORDER BY m.revenue DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN m.title, m.revenue

examples.question: Which movie has the highest revenue in the "Action" genre?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre {name: 'Action'}) WITH m ORDER BY m.revenue DESC LIMIT 1 RETURN m.title

examples.question: List the first 3 directors who died after 2000.
examples.cypher: MATCH (d:Director) WHERE d.died > date('2000-01-01') RETURN d.name, d.died ORDER BY d.died LIMIT 3

examples.question: Which three movies have the highest difference in revenue and budget?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.revenue IS NOT NULL AND m.budget IS NOT NULL RETURN m.title, m.revenue, m.budget, (m.revenue - m.budget) AS profit ORDER BY profit DESC LIMIT 3

examples.question: Which three directors have directed the most number of movies in a single year?
examples.cypher: MATCH (d:Director)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WITH d, m.year AS year, count(m) AS movies_count ORDER BY movies_count DESC RETURN d.name, year, movies_count LIMIT 3

examples.question: List all directors who have directed a movie in the 'Sci-Fi' genre.
examples.cypher: MATCH (d:Director)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre {name: 'Sci-Fi'}) RETURN d

examples.question: Which top 5 movies have been rated by more than 500,000 users?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[:RATED]-(u:User) WITH m, count(u) AS userCount WHERE userCount > 500000 RETURN m ORDER BY userCount DESC LIMIT 5

examples.question: What are the top 5 directors who have directed the most movies with a runtime under 90 minutes?
examples.cypher: MATCH (d:Director)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.runtime < 90 WITH d, count(m) AS moviesDirected ORDER BY moviesDirected DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN d.name, moviesDirected

examples.question: List the top 3 directors based on the number of different countries their movies have been released in.
examples.cypher: MATCH (d:Director)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WITH d, size(collect(distinct m.countries)) AS numCountries ORDER BY numCountries DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN d.name AS director, numCountries AS numberOfCountries

examples.question: List the first 3 movies that were shot in more than five different locations.
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE size(m.countries) > 5 RETURN m LIMIT 3

examples.question: Which movies have both high revenue (over 500 million USD) and high imdbRating (above 8.0)?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.revenue > 500000000 AND m.imdbRating > 8.0 RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle, m.revenue AS Revenue, m.imdbRating AS IMDbRating

examples.question: List the top 3 movies with the lowest imdbVotes released after 2000.
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.year > 2000 AND m.imdbVotes IS NOT NULL RETURN m ORDER BY m.imdbVotes ASC LIMIT 3

examples.question: What are the top 5 movies with the most revenue that are in the 'Sci-Fi' genre?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre {name: 'Sci-Fi'}) WHERE m.revenue IS NOT NULL RETURN m.title, m.revenue ORDER BY m.revenue DESC LIMIT 5

examples.question: What is the average IMDb rating of movies based on Shakespearean plays?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE toLower(m.plot) CONTAINS "shakespeare" RETURN avg(m.imdbRating) AS average_rating

examples.question: List the top 5 movies with the smallest budgets that have an imdbRating over 7.0.
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.imdbRating > 7.0 RETURN m.title, m.budget, m.imdbRating ORDER BY m.budget ASC LIMIT 5

examples.question: List all movies that have an IMDb rating and were released in the year 2000.
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.imdbRating IS NOT NULL AND m.year = 2000 RETURN m.title AS title, m.imdbRating AS imdbRating, m.released AS released

examples.question: Which 3 movies have been rated exactly 5 times by users?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[:RATED]-(u:User) WITH m, COUNT(u) AS ratingCount WHERE ratingCount = 5 RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle, ratingCount LIMIT 3

examples.question: Which movies have a runtime longer than 180 minutes?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.runtime > 180 RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle, m.runtime AS Runtime

examples.question: What are the names of the top 5 movies with a budget over 100 million dollars?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.budget > 100000000 RETURN m.title ORDER BY m.imdbRating DESC LIMIT 5

examples.question: Which directors were born in the USA?
examples.cypher: MATCH (d:Director) WHERE d.bornIn = "USA" RETURN d.name, d.born, d.died, d.url, d.imdbId, d.tmdbId

examples.question: Which actors have played in a movie and also directed a movie?
examples.cypher: MATCH (a:Actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WHERE exists {   MATCH (a)-[:DIRECTED]->(m2:Movie) } RETURN DISTINCT a.name

examples.question: List the first 3 actors who have acted in movies with a revenue of over 500 million USD.
examples.cypher: MATCH (a:Actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.revenue > 500000000 RETURN a.name LIMIT 3

examples.question: List the first 3 genres that have more than 50 movies associated with them.
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) WITH g, count(m) AS movieCount WHERE movieCount > 50 RETURN g.name AS Genre, movieCount ORDER BY movieCount DESC LIMIT 3

examples.question: Which top 5 movies have the most diverse range of spoken languages?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) RETURN m.title, m.languages, size(m.languages) AS num_languages ORDER BY num_languages DESC LIMIT 5

examples.question: List the top 5 movies with the most countries available in their languages list.
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.languages IS NOT NULL RETURN m.title, size(m.languages) AS languageCount ORDER BY languageCount DESC LIMIT 5

examples.question: What are the first 3 genres of movies that have been directed by directors born after 1980?
examples.cypher: MATCH (d:Director)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) WHERE d.born > date("1980-01-01") RETURN DISTINCT g.name ORDER BY g.name LIMIT 3

examples.question: List the top 5 movies that were released in the '90s.
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.released STARTS WITH '199' RETURN m.title, m.released, m.imdbRating ORDER BY m.imdbRating DESC LIMIT 5

examples.question: What is the most common genre among movies released in 2014?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie {year: 2014})-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) WITH g.name AS genre, count(*) AS movieCount ORDER BY movieCount DESC RETURN genre LIMIT 1

examples.question: What are the top 5 movies directed by directors born in Nebraska?
examples.cypher: MATCH (d:Director)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WHERE d.bornIn CONTAINS "Nebraska" RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle, m.imdbRating AS Rating ORDER BY Rating DESC LIMIT 5

examples.question: Which directors have a poster URL that includes 'w440_and_h660_face'?
examples.cypher: MATCH (d:Director) WHERE d.poster CONTAINS 'w440_and_h660_face' RETURN d.name, d.poster

examples.question: What is the name of the director who directed the movie with the highest revenue?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WITH max(m.revenue) AS maxRevenue, collect(m) AS movie UNWIND movie AS highestRevenueMovie MATCH (highestRevenueMovie)<-[:DIRECTED]-(d:Director) RETURN d.name

examples.question: List the directors who have directed movies with a runtime longer than the average runtime of all movies.
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WITH avg(m.runtime) AS average_runtime MATCH (d:Director)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.runtime > average_runtime RETURN DISTINCT d.name

examples.question: What are the top 5 movies with the highest IMDb rating that have been directed by the same director?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[:DIRECTED]-(d:Director) WITH d, m ORDER BY m.imdbRating DESC WITH d, collect(m)[0..5] AS topMovies RETURN d.name AS director, [movie IN topMovies | movie.title] AS movies, [movie IN topMovies | movie.imdbRating] AS ratings

examples.question: Which actor has acted in the most movies?
examples.cypher: MATCH (actor:Actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(movie:Movie) WITH actor, count(movie) AS movieCount ORDER BY movieCount DESC RETURN actor.name, movieCount LIMIT 1

examples.question: Which 3 movies have the highest number of actors involved?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(a:Actor) WITH m, COUNT(a) AS actorCount ORDER BY actorCount DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle, actorCount

examples.question: Which three genres have the highest average revenue per movie?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) WHERE m.revenue IS NOT NULL WITH g.name AS genre, avg(m.revenue) AS avgRevenue RETURN genre, avgRevenue ORDER BY avgRevenue DESC LIMIT 3

examples.question: Who are the directors of movies that have an IMDb rating greater than 8.0?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[:DIRECTED]-(d:Director) WHERE m.imdbRating > 8.0 RETURN DISTINCT d.name AS director

examples.question: Which three users have rated movies in the most number of different genres?
examples.cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:RATED]->(m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) WITH u, count(DISTINCT g) AS numGenres ORDER BY numGenres DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN u.name AS user, numGenres

examples.question: Find all movies that have the same release year as 'Toy Story' and list their titles and genres.
examples.cypher: MATCH (toyStory:Movie {title: 'Toy Story'}) WITH toyStory, toyStory.released AS toyStoryYear MATCH (otherMovies:Movie {released: toyStoryYear}) WITH otherMovies, toyStoryYear, [(otherMovies)-[:IN_GENRE]->(genres) | genres.name] AS genres RETURN otherMovies.title AS movieTitle, genres, toyStoryYear

examples.question: What are the top 5 movies with the most budget and were released after 2010?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.released >= '2011-01-01' AND m.budget IS NOT NULL RETURN m ORDER BY m.budget DESC LIMIT 5

examples.question: Which movie has the most user ratings?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[r:RATED]-() WITH m, count(*) AS ratingCount ORDER BY ratingCount DESC RETURN m.title AS movieTitle, ratingCount LIMIT 1

examples.question: Which movies have been rated by more than three users?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[:RATED]-(u:User) WITH m, count(u) AS userCount WHERE userCount > 3 RETURN m

examples.question: Which genre has the most movies?
examples.cypher: MATCH (:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(genre:Genre) WITH genre, count(*) AS movieCount ORDER BY movieCount DESC LIMIT 1 RETURN genre.name

examples.question: What is the total revenue generated by movies released in the 1990s?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.year >= 1990 AND m.year <= 1999 WITH sum(m.revenue) AS totalRevenue RETURN totalRevenue

examples.question: Which movies have a plot that includes the word 'love'?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.plot CONTAINS 'love' RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle, m.plot AS Plot

examples.question: What are the top 5 movies released in the 1990s by revenue?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.released >= '1990-01-01' AND m.released < '2000-01-01' AND m.revenue IS NOT NULL RETURN m ORDER BY m.revenue DESC LIMIT 5

examples.question: List the top 3 actors who have acted in both 'Action' and 'Romance' genres.
examples.cypher: MATCH (a:Actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m1:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g1:Genre {name: 'Action'}),       (a)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m2:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g2:Genre {name: 'Romance'}) WITH a, COUNT(DISTINCT m1) + COUNT(DISTINCT m2) AS movieCount ORDER BY movieCount DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN a.name AS actorName, movieCount

examples.question: Which 5 movies had their entire plot translated into more than one language?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE size(m.languages) > 1 RETURN m.title, m.languages LIMIT 5

examples.question: What is the total revenue of movies released in the 21st century?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.year >= 2001 RETURN sum(m.revenue) AS totalRevenue

examples.question: What are the top 5 movies with the highest budgets?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) RETURN m.title, m.budget ORDER BY m.budget DESC LIMIT 5

examples.question: List the titles of movies that belong to at least three different genres.
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) WITH m, size(collect(g)) AS genreCount WHERE genreCount >= 3 RETURN m.title

examples.question: List the top 5 movies with the largest budgets released before 2000.

examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.released >= '2011' RETURN m.title, m.revenue ORDER BY m.revenue DESC LIMIT 5

examples.question: List the top 5 movies that have been rated the lowest by users.
examples.cypher: MATCH (:User)-[r:RATED]->(m:Movie) RETURN m.title AS title, AVG(r.rating) AS avgRating ORDER BY avgRating ASC LIMIT 5

examples.question: List the top 3 movies that have been directed by actors.
examples.cypher: MATCH (a:Actor)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle, m.released AS ReleaseDate ORDER BY m.imdbRating DESC LIMIT 3

examples.question: What is the name of the genre associated with the movie "Jumanji"?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie {title: "Jumanji"}) MATCH (m)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) RETURN g.name

examples.question: Find all movies that have been rated by more than 1000 users.
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[:RATED]-(u:User) WITH m, count(u) AS userCount WHERE userCount > 1000 RETURN m

examples.question: Which 5 directors were born in the USA and have directed at least 3 movies?
examples.cypher: MATCH (d:Director)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WHERE d.bornIn CONTAINS 'USA' WITH d, count(m) AS numMovies WHERE numMovies >= 3 RETURN d.name, numMovies ORDER BY numMovies DESC LIMIT 5

examples.question: Which 3 actors have the most roles listed in their ACTED_IN relationships?
examples.cypher: MATCH (a:Actor)-[r:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WITH a, count(r) AS roles ORDER BY roles DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN a.name AS actorName, roles

examples.question: What is the average IMDb rating for movies in the genre 'Adventure'?
examples.cypher: MATCH (g:Genre {name: 'Adventure'})<-[:IN_GENRE]-(m:Movie) WITH avg(m.imdbRating) AS avgRating RETURN avgRating

examples.question: What are the top 5 movies with the most number of genres associated?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) WITH m, COUNT(g) AS genreCount ORDER BY genreCount DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle, genreCount

examples.question: Who are the top 3 actors based on the number of movies they have acted in?
examples.cypher: MATCH (a:Actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) RETURN a.name, count(m) AS movies_count ORDER BY movies_count DESC LIMIT 3

examples.question: Identify the first 3 directors who have directed a movie with an IMDb rating lower than 4.0.
examples.cypher: MATCH (d:Director)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.imdbRating < 4.0 RETURN DISTINCT d.name ORDER BY d.name LIMIT 3

examples.question: Find all movies that have been rated exactly 5 times.
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[:RATED]-(u:User) WITH m, COUNT(u) AS ratingCount WHERE ratingCount = 5 RETURN m.title AS movieTitle, m.movieId AS movieId

examples.question: Identify the first 3 genres most frequently linked to movies directed by 'Steven Spielberg'.
examples.cypher: MATCH (d:Director {name: 'Steven Spielberg'})-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) RETURN g.name AS genre, count(*) AS frequency ORDER BY frequency DESC LIMIT 3

examples.question: Name the top 5 movies with the most IMDb votes released before the year 2000.
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.year < 2000 RETURN m.title AS title, m.imdbVotes AS votes ORDER BY m.imdbVotes DESC LIMIT 5

examples.question: List the top 3 directors who have worked with the most number of actors.
examples.cypher: MATCH (d:Director)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(a:Actor) WITH d, count(DISTINCT a) AS actors_count ORDER BY actors_count DESC RETURN d.name, actors_count LIMIT 3

examples.question: Which 3 movies have the most number of votes cast by users?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) RETURN m.title, m.imdbVotes ORDER BY m.imdbVotes DESC LIMIT 3

examples.question: What are the names of the movies directed by persons born in 'Burchard, Nebraska, USA'?
examples.cypher: MATCH (d:Director {bornIn: 'Burchard, Nebraska, USA'})-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) RETURN m.title AS MovieName

examples.question: Find the top 5 movies released most recently.
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.released IS NOT NULL RETURN m ORDER BY m.released DESC LIMIT 5

examples.question: List 3 movies that were released in the 1990s and have an IMDB rating above 7.
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.year >= 1990 AND m.year < 2000 AND m.imdbRating > 7 RETURN m.title, m.year, m.imdbRating LIMIT 3

examples.question: Show the top 5 movies that have been rated exactly three times.
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE count{(u:User)-[:RATED]->(m)} = 3 RETURN m LIMIT 5

examples.question: What is the average IMDb rating of movies with a runtime under 90 minutes?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.runtime < 90 RETURN avg(m.imdbRating) AS averageImdbRating

examples.question: List the top 3 directors by the number of movies directed.
examples.cypher: MATCH (d:Director)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) RETURN d.name AS director, count(m) AS moviesDirected ORDER BY moviesDirected DESC LIMIT 3

examples.question: Find all movies that have a plot mentioning 'hero'.
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.plot CONTAINS 'hero' RETURN m

examples.question: List 3 movies directed by 'Anthony Stacchi'.
examples.cypher: MATCH (d:Director {name: 'Anthony Stacchi'})-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) RETURN m LIMIT 3

examples.question: What are the top 5 movies with the highest number of countries involved?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WITH m, size(m.countries) AS countryCount ORDER BY countryCount DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN m.title AS title, countryCount

examples.question: List all movies that have a revenue greater than their budget.
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.revenue > m.budget RETURN m.title

examples.question: What are the top 3 longest movies by runtime?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.runtime IS NOT NULL RETURN m ORDER BY m.runtime DESC LIMIT 3

examples.question: Which 5 movies have the highest average user rating? Limit to movies rated by at least 10 users.
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[r:RATED]-(:User) WITH m, avg(r.rating) AS avgRating, count(r) AS numRatings WHERE numRatings >= 10 RETURN m.title AS movieTitle, avgRating ORDER BY avgRating DESC LIMIT 5

examples.question: What are the first 3 genres in which Harold Lloyd has directed movies?
examples.cypher: MATCH (d:Director {name: "Harold Lloyd"})-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) RETURN g.name LIMIT 3

examples.question: List the top 3 users who have rated at least one movie in each genre available.
examples.cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[r:RATED]->(m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) WITH u, collect(DISTINCT g.name) AS genresRated, count(DISTINCT g.name) AS genreCount MATCH (g2:Genre) WITH u, genresRated, genreCount, collect(DISTINCT g2.name) AS allGenres WHERE genreCount = size(allGenres) RETURN u.name AS userName, size(genresRated) AS genresRatedCount ORDER BY genresRatedCount DESC LIMIT 3

examples.question: What are the top 5 movies with a single-country language setting and the highest imdbRating?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE size(m.countries) = 1 RETURN m.title, m.imdbRating ORDER BY m.imdbRating DESC LIMIT 5

examples.question: What are the first 3 movies with plots that involve a natural disaster?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.plot CONTAINS 'natural disaster' RETURN m.title, m.plot LIMIT 3

examples.question: List 3 movies released in 1995.
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.released STARTS WITH '1995' RETURN m.title LIMIT 3

examples.question: List the movies that have a plot mentioning 'kingdom'.
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.plot CONTAINS 'kingdom' RETURN m.title, m.plot

examples.question: Find movies where the sum of the revenue and budget is more than 1 billion dollars.
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE (m.revenue + m.budget) > 1000000000 RETURN m

examples.question: What are the top 5 countries where the most movies originate from based on the 'countries' property of movies?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) UNWIND m.countries AS country WITH country, count(m) AS movieCount ORDER BY movieCount DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN country, movieCount

examples.question: List the top 5 actors by number of different genres they've acted in.
examples.cypher: MATCH (a:Actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) WITH a, count(distinct g) AS genreCount ORDER BY genreCount DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN a.name AS actor, genreCount AS numberOfGenres

examples.question: What are the top 5 movies with the most distinct countries of origin?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.countries IS NOT NULL RETURN m.title, size(m.countries) AS numCountries ORDER BY numCountries DESC LIMIT 5
